meta.name: verl-rl-training
meta.description: Provides guidance for training LLMs with reinforcement learning using verl (Volcano Engine RL). Use when implementing RLHF, GRPO, PPO, or other RL algorithms for LLM post-training at scale with flexible infrastructure backends.

copy.tagline: 用强化学习训练大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用RLHF/GRPO/PPO等算法微调大模型。
copy.tagline_en: Train LLMs with reinforcement learning at scale.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are fine-tuning LLMs with RLHF/GRPO/PPO at scale.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 verl 库对大型语言模型进行强化学习训练，支持 GRPO、PPO 等算法，并处理从数据准备到训练监控的完整流程。
howto.when: 当你需要实现 RLHF、GRPO、PPO 等强化学习算法对 LLM 进行后训练，且需要灵活的基础设施后端时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRPO 训练 Qwen2.5-7B 做数学推理。
say.note: Claude 会提供配置和启动命令。

say.text: 如何配置 PPO 训练并添加 critic 模型？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through reinforcement learning training for large language models using the verl library, supporting algorithms like GRPO and PPO, and handling the full workflow from data preparation to training monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to implement RLHF, GRPO, PPO, or other RL algorithms for LLM post-training with flexible infrastructure backends.

say_en.text: Help me train Qwen2.5-7B with GRPO for math reasoning.
say_en.note: Claude will provide configuration and launch commands.

say_en.text: How to configure PPO training with a critic model?
say_en.note: Claude will explain differences from GRPO and configuration steps.
